annotation.title_clean: EuroHPC initiative for start-ups to boost European leadership in trustworthy Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: EuroHPC initiative for start-ups to boost European leadership in trustworthy Artificial Intelligence
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament legislative resolution approving, with amendments, a Council regulation amending the EuroHPC Regulation to create AI Factories and AI-dedicated supercomputers giving start-ups, SMEs and researchers access to computing for trustworthy AI. Robotics is mentioned only as one application area.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds an AI Factory pillar and objective to the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking
Joint Undertaking acquires and owns AI-dedicated supercomputers, with EU funding up to 50% of acquisition and operating costs
Access limited to proposals for trustworthy, ethical AI consistent with EU values, using an Ethics by Design approach
Hosting entities must have energy efficiency and sustainability plans
A one-stop shop for start-ups, SMEs and researchers; robotics named among strategic application areas
